turns.replyText:
Will I get a replacement or a refund?

Returns and exchanges YISE accepts gently used and unopened products within 30 days of purchase. Start the request in the Returns Center. Refunds are reduced by outbound and return shipping costs. Same-product tint exchanges are available within the policy window. The YISE team reviews every request. Keep the items until that review is complete. If a physical return is required, the team emails instructions and a prepaid label; allow 1–7 business days for approval and processing. Once approved, YISE processes the refund or exchange.
